sections.heading: The challenge
sections.body: Leads go cold when follow-up waits on email and voicemail. Teams need a channel customers actually answer, with the context reps need to reply well.

sections.heading: How it works
sections.body: Inbound leads trigger an instant text, replies land in a shared inbox, and reps pick up the conversation with full history.
